variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'Ye exact usury' renders a participle meaning 'lend on interest' either way: qere נֹשִׁים (from נשה) and ketiv נשאים (from נשא, cf. the noun מַשָּׁא) are orthographic variants of the same sense, and the English cannot tell them apart. The verse's only note (Or, deputies) is alternative_rendering on 'rulers' and touches a different word. Base fallback (qere) retained.
